_source: rsprox 1862 (Leagues V, rev 227, F1-F4) and 3299 (Grid Master, rev 234, F1-F5) from the osrs-captures index, unless a key says _wiki. Both worlds multiply XP (1862 x16, 3299 x15); XP here is the recorded value divided out. Tiles are template (source map) tiles.
_mausoleum: rsprox.net 3050 (rev 231): the Mausoleum Door in Darkmeyer (Enter) and the lobby's stairs up (Climb-up). Both fade out 2 ticks after arriving and move the player 2 ticks later; the door fades back in 1 tick after the move, the stairs 2. The fade closes 2 ticks after it fades in.
_floors: source: the SW corner of the 96x96 area each floor copies (12x12 chunks, planes 0-3); centre: the first teleport. Variants: the start tile and the varbits set at the floor's start, as recorded. agility: Wiki main page (52/62/72/77/87). xp: recorded completion XP / 15 (the Wiki's two tables disagree; see _xp).
_timer: Game ticks. 202 at the start of floor 1, +200 at each floor start; it stops at 1 (expired). Warnings when it shows these values. Token: +100 (Wiki: one extra minute).
_obstacles: Keyed by template tile 'x,y,z'. Drops, the middle stairs and the platforms' hops are recorded as listed; the pillar, bridge and portal geometry is derived from the loc (see Skills.HallowedSepulchre.js), which reproduces the recorded F3 pillar, F1 bridge and F3 portal.

drops._2543,5859,2: Not recorded (hallowed_floor_4_northpath_drop): every recorded drop lands by its face (f0 +1,-3; f1 -3,+1; f2 +1,+3; f3 +3,+1), so this f1 drop lands at -3,+1.

stairs._2285,5983,2: Not recorded (hallowed_floor_1_eastpath_stairs): floor 1 mirrors about x 2272 (the platforms 2265/2279, these stairs 2259/2285), so the mirror of 38464's landing. The floor 2 north and south stairs (38466, 38468) cannot be derived and no recorded layout uses them.

_platforms: Two hops of two tiles from the click side, 2 ticks apart (recorded). 38458 _01_west goes west, 38456 _01_east east, 38459 _02 north. The F5 stepping stones (38477) are three hops south, the last at 34 cycles.
_floor2Stones: hallowed_floor_2_steppingstone, four stones two tiles apart (not recorded): a hop onto the stone clicked, 10 Agility XP each (Wiki: Platform, floor 2 upper).
_finalBarriers: hallowed_final_chest_barrier (39540), the walls either side of the Grand Hallowed Coffin. A multiloc on hallowed_time_remaining: inactive while time is left, active at 0-1 (both variants are solid in the cache, so the floor lifts their collision until the timer runs out; recorded, 3299: "I can't reach that!" only after the barrier activated). The coffin itself is a multiloc on varbit 10432 (0 unlooted, 1 looted).
_obstacleXp: Agility XP: recorded / 15 (drop 25, stairs 25, platform 50, gate 50, stepping stones 100, pillar 75 on F3, bridge 50 on F1); the Wiki's per-floor values elsewhere. Pillar F1 50, F2 50, F3 75, F5 80; bridge F1 50, F4 75, F5 80; portal F3 75, F4 75, F5 80 (Wiki obstacle pages).

xp._wiki: Magic 200 per conjure, Prayer 200 per brazier, Construction by plank (plank 150, oak 300, teak 450, mahogany 700; recorded 2,400/16 = 150 with planks and steel nails).

_requirements: Wiki: Ranged 62 with a crossbow and a mith grapple (or a Hallowed grapple); Construction 56 with 2 planks, 5 nails, a saw and a hammer; Prayer 54 with 2 vampyre dust (1 with a Hallowed symbol); coffins Thieving 66; the grand coffin Thieving 84 or Agility 92 (Jagex update, 12 Aug 2026).
_quest: Wiki: the Sepulchre needs Sins of the Father completed. Unrecorded: the refusal's wording.
_enchants: Wiki: the portal takes any of the Lvl-1 to Lvl-7 Enchant spells; the highest one the player can cast is used. [magic level, [[rune, amount]]].

traps._source: rsprox 1862 and 3299 (a trap-by-trap pass over both recordings): every cycle counts from the floor's start (the tick its timer is set), phase = (tick - start) mod period. Fire statues pair with the blast tile in front by rotation; crossbow lanes target a fixed tile; swords go out to the far point, hold and come back; lightning strikes a checkerboard patch in front; pads push the player on or back along their travel 3-7 tiles. Rotation 0 south, 1 west, 2 north, 3 east.

fire._ids: Statues 38409-38412 fire on floors 1-2, 38413-38415 never (always idle); 38416-38425 by the tile group table (A, B or X = both). Blast 38427.
fire._cycle: [period, ready of group A, ready of group B]; on floors 1-2 every active statue is A.
fire._groups: Statue SW tiles not listed (none seen firing, or out of view) fire with both groups.
fire._seqs: Per tick from the statue ready (index 0). The blast hits on its start tick (ready+3); stepping onto it on +3..+5 hits the tick after.

crossbow._cycle: [period, ready] per floor; floor 3's level-1 statue (2399-2401,5822,1) keeps the 6-tick cycle.
crossbow._lanes: [x0, y0, x1, y1, z, target distance]: the three lanes of a statue and how far their bolts fly (fixed per lane, every run).

sword._swords: [x, y, z, step, far, returnStart, period]: the 3x3 sword NPC is added at ready+2 one step past the block in front, steps out to `far` (from the statue SW), starts back at `returnStart` (ticks from the add), is deleted 2 ticks after it is back; the statue is _thrown from the add+1 until the delete+2.

lightning._ids: [patch width, tile parity] by id: t2 a 3x3 X (5 tiles: corners and centre), t3 a 5x3 checker (the 8 tiles off the centre's parity).
lightning._statues: [x, y, z, gap]: the patch is centred gap+3 tiles in front of the statue centre.

pads._pads: Each pad keeps its own timer (6 ticks, sometimes longer): ready, then the telegraph a tick later; it is armed from the telegraph until 4 ticks after, then waits for the next telegraph.

traps._zones: [floor, x0, y0, x1, y1, z, respawn x, y, z]: the recorded hit areas and where each sent the player. A hit uses the nearest zone within zoneReach tiles on its plane, else the floor's last landing. Floor 3's level-1 zone respawns at (2398,5828,1) on layout B.
